en: Black-and-white image showing a cliff dwelling built into a large rock alcove, surrounded by trees and brush in the foreground. A ladder leads up toward the multi‑story masonry structures in the cliff face. The scene is framed like a tourist or historical site photograph. There is small printed text at the bottom identifying the site, along with a handwritten catalog number in the lower right corner.
